class Box {
  get value(): number { return 77; }
  set value(value: string | number) {}
  get plain(): number { return 33; }
  set plain(value: number) {}
}
function setInvalid<K extends 'value'>(box: Box, key: K, value: boolean) {
  box[key] = value;
}
function setAmbiguous<K extends 'value' | 'plain'>(box: Box, key: K, value: string) {
  box[key] = value;
}
function read<K extends 'value'>(box: Box, key: K) {
  const value: string = box[key];
  return value;
}
